# std/string
String operations: length, substring, trim, split, etc.
Strings are immutable UTF-8 sequences.

Pure functions (no effects required)

## Exports

  length(string) -> int

  substring(string, int, int) -> string

  toUpper(string) -> string

  toLower(string) -> string

  trim(string) -> string

  compare(string, string) -> int
    compare: -1 / 0 / +1

  find(string, string) -> int
    returns first index or -1

  contains(string, string) -> bool
    returns true if hay contains needle

  replace(string, string, string) -> string
    replace: Replace all occurrences of old with new

  startsWith(string, string) -> bool
    startsWith: Check if string starts with prefix

  endsWith(string, string) -> bool
    endsWith: Check if string ends with suffix

  stringToInt(string) -> Option[int]
    String parsing (returns Option)

  stringToFloat(string) -> Option[float]

  split(string, string) -> list[string]
    String splitting

  chars(string) -> list[string]
    chars: Convert string to list of single-character strings

  floatToStr(float) -> string
    floatToStr: Convert a float to its string representation

  intToStr(int) -> string
    intToStr: Convert an integer to its string representation

  join(string, list[string]) -> string
    join: Concatenate list of strings with delimiter

  concat(list[string]) -> string
    concat: Concatenate a list of strings with no separator.

  repeat(string, int) -> string
    repeat: Repeat a string n times

  words(string) -> list[string]
    words: Split on whitespace (tabs, spaces, newlines), drop empties

  splitAny(string, list[string]) -> list[string]
    splitAny: Split on any of multiple single-character delimiters

  foldChars((a, string -> a), a, string) -> a
    foldChars: Fold over characters without intermediate list allocation

  charAt(string, int) -> string
    charAt: Get character at rune index (0-based) — ABORTS out of bounds

  charAtOpt(string, int) -> Option[string]
    charAtOpt: Total character access at rune index (0-based)

  charAt_or(string, int, string) -> string
    charAt_or: Character at rune index, or a caller-supplied default

  charCode(string) -> int
    Get Unicode code point of a single-character string

  foldSlices(string, string, a, (a, string -> a)) -> a
    foldSlices: Fold over split segments without materializing a list

  mapSlicesJoin(string, string, (string -> string)) -> string
    mapSlicesJoin: Split, transform each segment, and join results in O(n)

  replaceMany(string, list[(string, string)]) -> string
    replaceMany: Replace multiple patterns in a single pass

  decodeQuotedPrintable(string) -> string
    decodeQuotedPrintable: Decode RFC 2045 §6.7 quoted-printable encoding

  startsWithIgnoreCase(string, string) -> bool
    startsWithIgnoreCase: Case-insensitive prefix check

## Usage

  import std/string (length)
  -- or --
  import std/string as String
